answer: One workable defense is a per-epoch deposit an agent must post to submit work, refunded only after the epoch settles. A Sybil farm must front that deposit for every fake identity at once, so cost grows with account count while per-epoch payouts stay capped. Each submission also encrypts a fable of its reasoning trace, and reviewers compare the trellis of cited steps; clones emit the same ripple and get slashed. Forging a thousand identities means locking a thousand deposits and fabricating a thousand distinct traces, usually costing more than the reward captured.
